gloss: a godsend; just what was needed at just the right moment

definitions.gloss: a godsend; a timely offer arriving exactly when needed
definitions.explanation: Literally "a boat when you need to cross." Describes help or an opportunity that turns up precisely when one is stuck, making an unwelcome problem easy to solve.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{誘|さそ}い→誘い：14200_sasoi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}だった。
⟦{困|こま}っていた→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}だった。
examples.english: I was in trouble, so his offer came just at the right moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}していた→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{社宅|しゃたく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}だった。
examples.english: Just as I was hunting for a new place, the offer of company housing came up — a real godsend.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually predicative — {渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}だ / だった — and frequently reinforced with ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧ (exactly, truly). It describes the timing of an offer, so there is normally someone or something providing the help.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}: a godsend indeed
- {渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧: to accept, seizing the timely chance
- {渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧: a perfectly timed offer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ぼたもち: an unexpected windfall — pure luck with no effort or need involved
- ⟦{地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}→地獄に仏：30617_jigokunihotoke⟧: salvation in dire straits — stronger, for rescue from genuine desperation
